source: The Ordo 2025-2026, compiled by Peter Day-Milne, copyright The Latin Mass Society 2025 (https://lms.org.uk). Facts only: the days, dates, classes and colours of the dioceses of England, taken by hand; the names are in Missalemeum's style. Feasts of single dioceses are left out.

occasions.name: St. Thomas of Canterbury, Bishop & Martyr
occasions.note: 29 December 2025: In all dioceses of England and Wales, St Thomas of Canterbury B M, I Cl, R. Replaces the universal commemoration of St Thomas Becket.

occasions.name: St. George, Martyr, Patron of England
occasions.note: 23 April 2026: In all dioceses of England, St George M, I Cl, R. Universally a commemoration.

occasions.name: Holy Martyrs of England & Wales
occasions.note: 4 May 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, The Holy Martyrs of England and Wales, III Cl, R.

occasions.name: St. Ubaldus
occasions.note: 16 May 2026: St Ubaldus B C, III Cl, W, on the Ordo's main line. Missalemeum has a commemoration.

occasions.name: St. Alban, Martyr
occasions.note: 22 June 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, St Alban M, III Cl, R.

occasions.name: Sts. John Fisher, Bishop, & Thomas More, Martyrs
occasions.note: 9 July 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, SS John Fisher B & Thomas More MM, I Cl, R.

occasions.name: St. Edward the Confessor, King
occasions.note: 13 October 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales (outside the City of Westminster, where it ranks higher), St Edward K C, II Cl, W. Universally III Cl.

occasions.name: St. Didacus
occasions.note: 13 November 2026: St Didacus C, III Cl, W, on the Ordo's main line. Missalemeum has a commemoration.
